description: This file defines a BroadcastReceiver subclass 'MessageReadReceiver' that listens for broadcast intents indicating that a message conversation has been read, logs the event, and cancels the associated notification.

classes.name: MessageReadReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that handles message read events to log and cancel notifications.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles the broadcast indicating that a conversation has been read. It retrieves the conversation ID, logs the read event, and cancels the associated notification.
